title: Nitinol developed from the Roswell crash
summary: Grant Cameron tells of Nitinol developed from the Roswell crash, about 1947 at Roswell, New Mexico, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: metal I well some like metal nitall I think was something developed from the Roswell crash

plain: A researcher named Grant Cameron, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, says he thinks a metal called nitinol was developed from the Roswell crash, the reported 1947 crash of an unknown craft near Roswell, New Mexico. If true, it would mean a material in use today came from studying a craft that was not made by people.
